extracted.name: Cranberry Pork Chops
extracted.description: Sweet cranberry pork chops simmered to perfection for an easy weeknight meal that feels festive and tastes delicious.
instruction_lines: In a skillet, brown pork chops slowly in oil; drain.

Add cranberries, sugar, salt, and pepper to chops with 1/2 cup water to start. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for about 45 minutes or until tender but not dry. Add water if necessary to keep chops from drying out.
